name: 4-HO-MPMI
summary: A rare tryptamine derivative first synthesised by David Nichols. This drug, also known as lucigenol, has rarely been documented outside the lab. It is known to be a psychedelic similar to other psychoactive tryptamines, with a potency similar to DOI. Little else is known about the drug.
advisory: As of writing this note, this substance has not been reported on dosages past 2mg. Caution should be given when dosing. The drug is near eqipotent to DOI.
doseBasis: Note: As of writing this note, this substance has not been reported on dosages past 2mg. Caution should be given when dosing. The drug is near eqipotent to DOI.

pharmacology.text: The affinity (Ki) of 4-HO-MPMI for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor has been found to be 13 nM. It produces psychedelic-appropriate responding in animal tests with similar potency as DOI. The drug has two enantiomers, with only the (R)-enantiomer being active.

uses.en: It is a research compound and has rarely been documented outside the laboratory.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，在實驗室以外很少有紀錄。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，在实验室以外很少有纪录。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psilocin-like tryptamines, can cause nausea, yawning, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類、類似脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（psilocin）的色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类、类似脱磷酸裸盖菇素（psilocin）的色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It was made in David Nichols's lab, with the amine tied into a pyrrolidine ring to hold it in one shape. It comes in two mirror-image forms, and they differ in how active they are.
fact.zh: 它是在David Nichols的實驗室中合成的，胺基被綁進一個吡咯烷環中，使分子固定在某種形狀。它有兩種互為鏡像的形式，兩者的活性並不相同。
fact.zhHans: 它是在David Nichols的实验室中合成的，胺基被绑进一个吡咯烷环中，使分子固定在某种形状。它有两种互为镜像的形式，两者的活性并不相同。
